featured_reviews.name: Gloria Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not even worth 0 stars. We had placed a bulk order for sweets and were informed twice that the order would be ready by 9.30 AM. The staff had the audacity to tell us that the order will take more than 2 hours to be ready at 10 AM on the day of delivery. The staff doesn’t know how to speak to the customer. Only after we raised our voice did they put the staff to work and we got the order within 30 minutes. The owner doesn’t care about the customer experience as well.

There are far more better places in Vasai that have superior quality of products as well as customer experience.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shri Aai Ashram may have its beginnings at Om Nagar, but this Vasai West branch near Sai Mandir has carved its own niche in my heart. Memories of school mornings fueled by their golden, crispy samosas still spark joy, and this New Year's sweet shopping trip just cemented their place as a Vasai favorite.

Walking into Shri Aai Ashram is like stepping into a wonderland of sugary delights. The variety is truly mind-blowing! From traditional Indian mithai like pedas and barfis to modern innovations like chocolate-stuffed gulab jamuns, they have something to tantalize every taste bud. I was particularly impressed by their selection of sugar-free options, a thoughtful touch for health-conscious sweet lovers.

It's not just the sweets that make Shri Aai Ashram special. The friendly owner and staff radiate genuine warmth, making every visit a pleasure. They're always happy to offer recommendations and answer questions, creating a welcoming atmosphere that extends beyond the counter.

Whether you're a local with childhood memories like me or a curious newcomer, Shri Aai Ashram is a must-visit. It's not just a sweet shop, it's a testament to Vasai's love affair with delectable treats and warm hospitDon't miss out on this Vasai gem. Shri Aai Ashram will satisfy your sweet tooth and leave you with a smile, just like it did for me.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan in Vasai and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed! This is the oldest sweet mart in Vasai and has been serving delicious treats for decades. It's no wonder why all the local schools, colleges, and offices order their samosas from here.

As soon as I walked in, I was hit with a wave of nostalgia. The old-school charm of the place instantly transported me back to simpler times. What made it even better was the fact that the staff was the same as it was 15 years ago! It's truly heartwarming to see the same smiling faces behind the counter, still dedicated to serving their customers with the same passion.

But let's talk about the food. The samosas were out of this world. Perfectly crispy on the outside and filled with the most delicious mixture of spiced potatoes on the inside. It's no wonder why this place has such a loyal following.

And if you're not in the mood for samosas, don't worry. Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan offers a wide variety of mouth-watering treats that will satisfy any craving. From sweets to savory snacks, everything is made fresh daily and with the utmost care.

Overall, I highly recommend Tungareshwar Sweet & Farsan to anyone in Vasai or the surrounding area. The nostalgic atmosphere combined with the delicious food and friendly staff make this place a must-visit. Don't miss out on this gem of a sweet mart!
